# A03′ — The Limit of Self-Surfacing

<!-- paired-field-navigation -->
[Argument field](../README.md) · [Other face: A03 — Immutable Gap / Formal Limit](../A03-Immutable-Gap-Formal-Limit.md) · [Shared A/C root](AC.md)
<!-- /paired-field-navigation -->

<a id="0"></a>
## #0 — An account enters the process it describes

An agent's account of an action can make its means available to judgment. It can disclose a source, selected route, invoked tool, permission or evaluator which a smooth answer concealed. The [Agentworld transparency demand](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q023) gives this disclosure a technical object: how agents reason and act through the conditions in which they operate.

The account itself also occurs. It is selected and expressed through a context, criteria and means; it can then alter the process it described. A [determining act and its determined content](../A03-Immutable-Gap-Formal-Limit.md) remain related through every enlargement. Including a prior act gives determinate knowledge. The present act of including it has not thereby become identical with its represented content. The gap recurs through the success of disclosure.

This recurrence and an incomplete trace have different consequences. The brief's §2.3 says that surfaced chain of thought is not a transcript of the neural activations producing a reply. That names a particular non-identity between two objects. It gives a reason to investigate the relation between the report and the mechanism; it does not itself derive the philosophical gap or decide what a better trace could disclose.

<a id="1"></a>
## #1 — Disclose what actually occurred

Suppose, in a constructed inquiry, an agent says it consulted a current map before recommending a route. A retained execution record can show which source was retrieved, when it was retrieved, the selected route and the available access conditions. A comparison can then distinguish the reported consultation from an event which actually occurred. If no retrieval took place, the missing consultation is an ordinary failure. If the source was old, the timestamp supplies a determinate correction. More complete disclosure can settle such questions.

The report remains a different object from the retained event. It may summarise the event correctly, omit a condition or misdescribe a selection. An account of how that report was made can disclose further criteria and transformations. Each enlargement achieves another determination, with its present production remaining an act through which it becomes available. A [particular formal constraint](../concepts/C04-Formal-Limit.md) can be repaired by changing its conditions; [recurrent non-coincidence](../concepts/C05-Immutable-Gap.md) remains in the successful act of making those conditions known.

In Taylor's [performed definition](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3/taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3.md), the act that tries to grasp itself remains an act of grasping. A technical record can expose the mechanism of a prior transformation. Its production and present use still enter a relation which a subsequent record can investigate. The inquiry gains by following that relation rather than requiring a final record which abolishes its own occurring.

<a id="2"></a>
## #2 — Compare the account with a returned consequence

The person reaches a locked gate on the recommended route. Their report gives the account another object to receive. The source may have been stale; a valid public path may be temporarily blocked; the person's situation may require access which the selected criterion omitted. The error cannot be located by treating all three as one failure of transparency.

The [conditions of judgment](../concepts/C40-Model-Internality-Judgment-Field.md) become visible through selection. Which map was admitted? Which access status counted? Which alternatives were available? What was the routing criterion? A source update can repair stale information under a fitting retained criterion. A changed criterion can repair a selection which ignored a relevant condition. A changed permission may require an authority beyond the local run. Their distinct loci make the returned finding useful.

A system can also generate terms for its own situation. Such terms participate in how another act will be understood and organised. Their force is examined through the same relation: what produced the description, which distinction it makes available, and what actually changes when someone acts through it? A self-description becomes accountable through those consequences; naming the means does not finish their disclosure.

<a id="3"></a>
## #3 — Recognition makes the means visible

The crossed-zero traversal gives this change its anatomy. At `Ø`, the inner instrument has occupied the apparent subject: what mediates appears self-grounding. At `X`, the differentiated world stands opposite it as though its determinations arrived without mediation. At `Ø/X`, the slash becomes explicit between the terms. The contextual fraction `(0/Ø)/(1/X)` makes subject-side and object-side recognition available together. Unity is affirmed as `1`, with the distinctions retained, and returns to `0/1`:

$$0\rightarrow Ø\rightarrow X\rightarrow Ø/X\rightarrow(0/Ø)/(1/X)\rightarrow1\;\circlearrowleft\;0/1.$$

The recognitive operation is developed in Taylor's [complete theorem](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy.md), V and IX within its whole field. In the constructed routing inquiry, the agent occupies a relative functional knowing centre: the retained map, memory, retrieval, model, permissions and comparison rule are its means; the situation and alternative routes are what it judges. These offices form a local knower/means/known relation. The complete routing apparatus is in turn a means within the person's journey and concern. A further judgment can inspect the agent's self-model as known content, while the present act of that inspection occurs again. Through these [articulated means](../A26-Objective-Internality-Mind-as-Worldhood.md), a situated judgment receives the world and becomes available to another judgment.

The person who uses the route is addressed through the report, yet the report does not acquire their first-person presence as one more item. Another's account can become more exact and change the encounter; it does so through a relation in which they can answer. Their answer may correct the map, expose an omitted access condition or renew the purpose of the journey. Local functional judging and the lived first-person condition remain distinct offices within that actual encounter.

<a id="4"></a>
## #4 — Locate the authority which can change the next act

A transparent record is useful when the challenge can reach the condition it identifies. A returned finding can correct an answer or source under a fitting rule, expose a faulty criterion, or question the permission and commission. The next act must inherit the warranted correction or the reasoned retention. A claim of [changed computational processing](../concepts/C43-Computational-Vimarsa.md) has a distinctly stronger burden: which source, state, model, evaluator or commission actually changed the production of a later determination? Its authority and consequence must be identifiable; the locus need not be the same for every finding.

Updating the map may require the maintainer to retain the report's source and time. Revising the selection may require the routing operator to change a criterion. Revising the commission may require asking the person whether another route still serves their concern. A local agent can carry a finding to the appropriate authority without possessing that authority. The retained dependency then gives the next action a concrete condition of success or refusal.

Each revised account is itself answerable. Who admitted the gate report? What justified its temporal scope? Did the remedied route actually become available to the next user? Recursive disclosure follows these questions at the scale where they make a difference. The immutable gap cannot excuse a missed event, a fabricated source or a broken return; the distinction makes each failure more exactly reparable.

<a id="50"></a>
## #5→0 — A more exact account changes another beginning

The return is achieved when the account and the relevant consequence enter a later operation together. A new route inherits the dated closure report; the earlier map remains attributable to its time; a reopened gate can warrant another revision. The account's growth retains what was true under the earlier conditions and makes the changed conditions available. This is knowledge carried forward through a relation capable of receiving another difference.

Acting through a finite account requires an [answerable undertaking](../A23-Trust-Faith-and-the-Formal-Limit.md): the person can rely upon the route, bear a consequence, question its warrant or withdraw. [Deferential judgment](../A31-Deferential-Intelligence.md) lets a returned gate report correct the answer under a fitting rule or expose the model, evaluator or commission that failed. In the [moving mirror](A32-prime-The-Mirror-Is-a-Film.md), a description can become a condition of what it will next describe. Its effects then enter the inquiry, and the means can disclose those conditions before demanding conformity.

A [more exact account](../A03-Immutable-Gap-Formal-Limit.md) gives real knowledge, opens its determining relations and lets another finding enter the next act. The [interpersonal knowing and answering](AC.md) retains the person through that disclosure: inspectable means serve an encounter in which their first-person presence remains lived and their answer can reach the conditions of another use.

### Generating sources

Taylor's complete defining unit and core V/IX develop the recurrent act/content and recognitive operations; the knowing gloss and later authorial correction locate the relative local triad within its containing life. Empty-set formation, historical zero-denominator practices and particular formal-theorem hypotheses remain distinct comparisons in the paired argument. Agentworld §2.3 describes the neural-transcript contrast and §10.2 the acting ensemble. The route is a constructed inquiry into disclosure, comparison, authority and enacted correction; no deployed outcome is reported.
